Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275)
Order under Section 11 (3)
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in the loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 8th April 1996:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 30th April 1996, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1) The Bankruptcy Act (Chapter 20).
(2) The Contact Lens Practitioners Act (Chapter 53A).
(3) The Distress Act (Chapter 84).
(4) The Economic Expansion Incentives (Relief from Income Tax) Act (Chapter 86).
(5) The Employment Act (Chapter 91).
(6) The Income Tax Act (Chapter 134).
(7) The Land Transport Authority of Singapore Act (Chapter 158A).
(8) The Legal Aid and Advice Act (Chapter 160).
(9) The Maintenance of Parents Act (Chapter 167B).
(10) The Merchant Shipping Act (Chapter 179).
(11) The National Library Board Act (Chapter 197).
(12) The Parliamentary Pensions Act (Chapter 219).
(13) The Pension Fund Act (Chapter 224A).
(14) The Public Utilities Act (Chapter 261).
(15) The Rapid Transit Systems Act (Chapter 263A).
(16) The Regulation of Imports and Exports Act (Chapter 272A).
(17) The Sale of Goods (United Nations Convention) Act (Chapter 283A).
(18) The Singapore Productivity and Standards Board Act (Chapter 303A).
(19) The Street Works Act (Chapter 320A).
